implementation.name: Irem M92 (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 74 HDL source files (35 systemverilog, 35 verilog, 4 vhdl) alongside 7 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: 29 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 12 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 17 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 13 distinct machine_id rows. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-IremM92_MiSTer/blob/main/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 2 text, and the grant in https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-IremM92_MiSTer/blob/main/Arcade-IremM92.sv reads "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 74 source files (35 systemverilog, 35 verilog, 4 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
